basic.name: My Sword Zaps Demons
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of March 7th's ATK to a single target enemy and gains 1 point(s) of Charge.

variants.name: Brows Be Smitten, Heart Be Bitten
variants.description_template: Initially, deals 3 hits, each causing Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of March 7th's ATK to a single target enemy. Whenever dealing the final hit, there is a 60% fixed chance to deal 1 additional hit of DMG, up to a max of 3 additional hit(s). Energy regenerated from using Enhanced Basic ATK does not increase with the number of hits. Enhanced Basic ATK cannot recover Skill Points.

skill.name: Fractal, Exiles Fallacy
skill.description_template:
Designates one ally (excluding this unit) as "Shifu" and increases "Shifu"'s SPD by {{increased_spd}}%. Only the most recent target of March 7th's Skill is considered as "Shifu."
Whenever using Basic ATK or dealing 1 hit of Enhanced Basic ATK's DMG, triggers the corresponding effect if "Shifu" with the specified Path is present on the field:
Erudition, Destruction, The Hunt, Remembrance, Elation: Deals Additional DMG (DMG Type based on "Shifu"'s Combat Type) equal to {{additional_dmg}}% of March 7th's ATK.
Harmony, Nihility, Preservation, Abundance: Increases the Toughness Reduction of this instance of DMG by 100%.

ultimate.name: March 7th, the Apex Heroine
ultimate.description_template:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{img_dmg}}% of March 7th's ATK to a single target enemy.
Increases the initial Hits Per Action of the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 2 hits and increase the fixed chance of additionally dealing DMG by 20%.

talent.name: Master, I've Ascended!
talent.description_template:
After Shifu uses an attack or Ultimate, March 7th gains up to 1 point of Charge each time.
Upon reaching 7 or more points of Charge, March 7th immediately takes action and increases the DMG she deals by {{increased_damage}}%. Her Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and her Skill cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 7 point(s) of Charge. Charge is capped at 10 points.

technique.name: Feast in One Go
technique.description:
If March 7th is on the team, she gains 1 point of Charge at the start of the next battle whenever a teammate uses Technique, up to a max of 3 point(s).
After using Technique, March 7th regenerates 30 Energy when the next battle starts.

2.name: Swan Soar
2.description: When the battle starts, March 7th's action advances by 25%.

4.name: Filigree
4.description: March 7th can reduce the Toughness of enemies whose Weakness Type is the same as Shifu's Combat Type. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

6.name: Tide Tamer
6.description: After using Enhanced Basic ATK, increases Shifu's CRIT DMG by 60% and Break Effect by 36%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: My Sword Stirs Starlight
eidolons.description: When Shifu is on the field, increases March 7th's SPD by 10%.

eidolons.name: Blade Dances on Waves' Fight
eidolons.description: After "Shifu" uses Basic ATK or Skill to attack an enemy target, March 7th immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK and deals Imaginary DMG equal to 60% of March 7th's ATK to the primary target of this attack. Additionally, triggers the corresponding effect based on "Shifu"'s Path and then gains 1 point(s) of Charge. If there is no primary target available to attack, then she attacks a single random enemy instead. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

eidolons.name: Sharp Wit Martial Might
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Being Fabulous Never Frights
eidolons.description: At the start of the turn, regenerates 5 Energy.

eidolons.name: Sword Delights, Sugar Blights
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Me, the Best Girl in Sight
eidolons.description: After using Ultimate, increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 50%.
